credit: Duke City Ledger, from NCUA call reports

rules.missing_account: An account a quarter doesn't have is not available: null, drawn as a gap, never 0.
rules.blank_value: An account that exists but was left blank is not reported: null, and the table says which.
rules.zero: Stored only when the credit union reported zero.
rules.units: Dollars are whole dollars. ACCT_998 is percent times 100.
